LG_LEVEL_ROUNDS.note: IDENTICAL Lossguide exact batch: when max_leaves >= 2^max_depth (parameter test) the round width is the free slots, so one round splits a full depth level (about max_depth+1 rounds a tree instead of log2(max_leaves)+max_leaves/32). Bit-neutral: the best-first replay (_lg_exact_plan) still fixes leaf choice and numbering; same argument as LG_EXACT_ID at any width. Overrides the exact batch width (LG_EXACT_BATCH_WIDTH; T17_BATCH's define is deleted) whenever its condition holds; the LG_EXACT_ID memory gate still applies after it.
